title: Add ReminderMessage
description: Single shared builder for the dose-reminder notification title/text, replacing the two independent copies of this string previously in DailyListViewModel.logDose() and BootReminderReceiver.onReceive() -- resolves the 'Reminder title/text is duplicated' tech debt item.
acceptance_criteria: object ReminderMessage with a build(medicationName: String, dueAtEpochMillis: Long): Pair<String, String> function

Formats dueAtEpochMillis as a time-of-day string (e.g. h:mm a pattern) using a new SimpleDateFormat instance per call, not a cached/shared field, since SimpleDateFormat isn't thread-safe and this is called from multiple coroutine contexts
Returns a title of the form "<medicationName> dose due" and text of the form "Dosage due at: <formatted time>"
